subdivision_of_building: Forecourt area only, the Proposed Development does not affect the buildings or rear amenity areas.
description: Formation of hard and soft landscaping to create 29no. car parking spaces, 6no. motorcycle parking spaces, 66no. cycle parking spaces and 2no bin stores.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed 16, 10G, 15C, 24070 - 001 Rev B, 24070 - TK01 Rev A, 24070 - TK02 Rev A, 24070 - TK03 Rev A, SURFACE WATER DRAINAGE STRATEGY dated SEPTEMBER 2024, Ecological Walkover Survey dated 17th March 2026, Preliminary Ecological Appraisal dated 25/07/2024, Arboricultural Method Statement Dated 10 June 2026, Arbtech TPP 01 Rev B,  Arbtech AIA 01 Rev B, Reasonable Exception Statement produced by fire engineer Phil Barry
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 3 - No development shall commence until a Construction Environmental Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include:

(a) measures to protect retained and adjacent habitats, including the River Graveney, from the effects of construction activities including vehicle movements, lighting, dust, litter, noise and runoff;

(b) measures to prevent the entrapment of or harm to wildlife within excavations and construction materials;

(c) procedures for protecting nesting birds, including pre-commencement checks where works occur during the bird nesting season; and

(d) details of any construction lighting and measures to prevent impacts on protected and priority species, including commuting bats.

The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.


Reason: To protect biodiversity and neighbouring habitats during construction. in accordance with LP55 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023)

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of development, a Landscape and Ecological Enhancement and Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include details of planting, including species schedules and planting plans; details of biodiversity enhancement measures, including bird and bat features; details of measures to improve habitat connectivity; and details of any external lighting and measures to ensure that it does not adversely affect biodiversity or adjacent habitats. The approved measures shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.


Reason: To secure biodiversity enhancement and ecological improvements associated with the development in accordance woth LP55 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 5 - Prior to the first use of the development, a Car Park Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Plan shall be implemented prior to first use of the development and adhered to thereafter.


Reason: To ensure the satisfactory management and operation of the parking facilities in accordance with LP50 and LP51 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 6 - Prior to commencement of above ground works (excluding demolition), details of the location, number and design of secure and covered cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The cycle parking shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to the occupation of the development and be retained for cycle parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose.
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for cycle parking in accordance with Council policies LP2, LP51 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the commencement of development, details of all hard landscaping materials, including the specification and extent of permeable and impermeable paving, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to secure appropriate sustainable drainage measures in accordance with Policies LP1, LP5 and LP12 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 8 - Prior to the commencement of above ground works (excluding demolition), details of the siting, design and materials of refuse and recycling storage to serve the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The refuse storage facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation of the development, and shall be retained thereafter.
Reason: In the interests of amenity and hygiene, in accordance with Council policy LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 9 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
